growing point.  Celeriac is hardier than
celery and keeps well in winter if stored
in a cool place.  Thus, it is available year-
round, with a peak season lasting from
November through April.
Uses
Small to medium-sized celeriac roots that
are heavy for their size and free of cuts,
bruises, and soft spots are the best. The
roots should be stored with their stalks
intact in perforated plastic bags in the
refrigerator crisper.
